description: Hand-written 2-minute call: gatekeeper, a vendor objection, discovery, pitch, booked meeting. Labels are the intended block and the prospect's stance.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Good morning, Cedar Dental, this is Maria speaking.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Hi Maria, this is Sam from Brightline. Could I speak with Dr. Patel, please?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Can I ask what this is regarding?

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Sure, it's about the no-shows on her schedule. I'll keep it to a minute.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: One moment, I'll see if she's free.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: This is Dr. Patel.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Hi Dr. Patel, Sam from Brightline. We help dental practices cut no-shows, and I'm calling because you opened a second location this year.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Could I have thirty seconds to explain why I called, and you tell me if it's relevant?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Honestly, I'm between patients, and we already have a reminder system.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Makes sense, you already send reminders. Out of curiosity, are no-shows still a problem with them?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: I mean, a bit. The texts go out, but people still don't show up, especially on Mondays.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: How many would you say you lose on a typical Monday?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Maybe three or four slots at the new location. The front desk ends up calling the waitlist by hand.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: And how long does that take them each morning?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Half an hour at least. Maria hates it, honestly. It's the worst part of her Monday.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: That's the part we fix. When someone cancels, Brightline texts your waitlist automatically and fills the slot, usually within twenty minutes.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Does it work with Dentrix? That's what we use at both offices.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: It does. It syncs both ways, so Maria doesn't have to re-enter anything.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Okay. What does it cost? We just spent a lot on the new office.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: It depends on the number of chairs. Easiest is a fifteen-minute call where I show it on your schedule. Would Thursday at 12:30 or Friday at 8 work?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Friday morning is tough. Thursday lunchtime could work.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Great, Thursday at 12:30. What's the best email for the invite?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Send it to drpatel at cedardental dot com, and copy Maria.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it right after this call, with Maria copied.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Sounds good. I have to get back to my patient.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Of course. Thanks, Dr. Patel, talk to you Thursday.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Bye.
